title: My Rock Hatched a Dragon. (Part 1)
summary: Pebble frees the dragon he raised, and together they break the war giant’s chains before a louder roar answers from beyond the mountains.
frame_0: A bolt strikes baby Spark in midair above the square. Pebble shields his eyes in the foreground beneath THE EGG and MY ROCK HATCHED A DRAGON.
package_differences: The separate SHARED RULES sheet was unavailable. Production used Jake’s 52-line visual brief and the standing channel rules.
Some original caption lettering was reconstructed from the locked words where it could not be separated cleanly from the old picture.
scheduling_note: Allow at least three days between this film and My Blank Book Called a Storm Dragon.
